messages:
Priya: Heads-up: vendor pentest scheduled 2026-10-12 09:00-15:30 UTC. Need RBAC freeze window, KMS decrypt-proxy (no key export), immutable audit snapshot, and one evidence owner. Volunteers?

Jon: I can own RBAC freeze + rollback playbook. Propose freeze 08:30-16:00 UTC to provide buffers. Will enumerate affected roles.

Marta: I'll own evidence snapshot + manifest. Plan: export CloudTrail + host logs for window, create tar.gz, object-lock it, publish sha256. Delivery via presigned URL only.

Kai: KMS plan: implement decrypt-proxy Lambda that assumes an assessor-scoped role and performs KMS:Decrypt only for specific S3 object ARNs. No key policy changes. Need assessor acct and prefixes.

Priya: Assessor acct 808080808080. Platform: confirm retention and presigned delivery, and pause key rotations for alias/pt-evidence-key during window.

Infra Bot: Created ticket SEC-PT-9201: RBAC freeze + decrypt-proxy + snapshot. Assignees: @Jon, @Marta, @Kai. ETA: initial artifacts 48h.

Jon: Draft freeze checklist: pause CI deploys, block iam:CreateRole/PutRolePolicy during window, apply least-privilege read-only to pt-evidence prefixes. I'll publish exact ARNs.

Marta: Snapshot path: pt-evidence/snapshots/2305000000_window.tar.gz, manifest pt-evidence/manifests/2305000000.sha256. Retain exports 90 days.

Kai: Decrypt-proxy notes: validate caller account + object path, log assumeRole + decrypt in CloudTrail, avoid iam:PassRole. We'll ensure encryption context includes object id.

Priya: Oncall: who triages noisy scans? Jon primary, Marta backup. If customer-facing impact, escalate to IR bridge.

Jon: I'll run dry-run Fri 09:00 UTC to validate freeze and rollback steps.

Marta: I'll produce a sample snapshot and verify sha256; attach sample to SEC-PT-9201.

Kai: I'll deploy decrypt-proxy to staging and capture CloudTrail entries for audit visibility.

Priya: Acceptance criteria (add one-liners to SEC-PT-9201 by EOD): e.g. "Snapshot exported + sha256 verified", "Assessors decrypt only via proxy for designated prefixes", "RBAC freeze applied + rollback tested". Pre-check Thu 08:45 UTC 15m.

Jon: Added: "Freeze applied and rollback validated."

Marta: Added: "Snapshot created and checksum verified."

Kai: Added: "Decrypt-proxy logs show assessor assume + decrypt events under proxy role."

Priya: Thanks — ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
